Description.Name: Construction Materials Gathered
Description.Details:
<color=#BFBFBF>Darius taps through a supply manifest as the last container gets logged into the hold.</color> "That's the last of it, Commander. Cable and data line, the conduit to run it all through, a solid stock of sensors and probes, and a full set of communications gear to tie the hangar together with the rest of the Argo."

<color=#BFBFBF>Yang leans over his shoulder, scanning the list.</color> "Everything we needed for the wiring and the eyes and ears of the place. Hangar's actually starting to look like it might work one day. Once we finally find the structural material, we will have everything we need to finish the job properly."

Description.Name: Acknowledge the report
Description.Details: You look over the manifest one last time and nod. "Good work, both of you. Get it all staged and ready to go." Darius gives a small nod and heads off to arrange the staging. Yang claps a hand on a nearby crate. "Just say the word once we've got the rest, Commander. We'll be ready. [The naval-grade [[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_FerroAluminum],Ferro-Aluminum]] still needed for the hangar's structure can be recovered from the cargo containers of IndustrialMechs or cargo vehicles. Salvage from Ambush Convoy contracts offers the best chance of finding such containers.]
